raw_text:
Review README.md and /src files for repository purpose/structure and update this overview accordingly.

**Stack:** .NET 10.0 (`net10.0`), latest C#, nullable/implicit usings, `TreatWarningsAsErrors=true`; XML warning 1591 suppressed via `NoWarn`. Projects inherit [Directory.Build.props](Directory.Build.props). Central package management: `ManagePackageVersionsCentrally=true`; versions belong in [Directory.Packages.props](Directory.Packages.props), `.csproj` references omit versions. Add packages with `<PackageVersion Include="PackageName" Version="x.y.z" />`.

**Layout:** `src/` production, `tests/` tests, `Directory.Build.props`, `Directory.Packages.props`, `Template.slnx`.

**Style:** File-scoped namespaces, 2-space indentation, CRLF, UTF-8 BOM, Allman braces; braces except single-line exits; `csharp_prefer_braces = true`; `csharp_new_line_before_open_brace = all`. Private fields underscore camelCase; constants PascalCase; `var` for built-ins/apparent types; `I` interfaces; `Async` suffix. Prefer primary constructors, always assigning readonly fields; top-level entry points; pattern matching; expression-bodied properties/indexers/accessors, but NOT methods. Run `dotnet format`. Use analyzers from [Directory.Build.props](Directory.Build.props); consider NSDepCop. See [.editorconfig](.editorconfig).

**Security/config:** Use `appsettings.json`, `appsettings.{Environment}.json`, `IConfiguration`, `IOptions<T>`, strongly typed settings, and User Secrets for development. Never hardcode sensitive information in source code. Use `Microsoft.Extensions.Logging`, appropriate levels (`Trace`, `Debug`, `Information`, `Warning`, `Error`, `Critical`), context, structured logging, and correlation IDs when possible; avoid sensitive data. Use `Ardalis.GuardClauses` for non-UI validation and prefer `FluentValidation` for complex/UI validation. UI invalid input gets user-friendly errors; non-UI invalid input throws appropriate guard-clause exceptions. Return suitable HTTP status codes. Follow OWASP; validate/sanitize inputs; parameterized queries/ORM; authentication/authorization; HTTPS.

**Design:** Unit-testable focused classes/methods, ideally under 20 lines; DI; composition over inheritance; async I/O; parameter objects over 4 arguments; FastEndpoints `REPR`; DDD where applicable. API messages `*Request`/`*Response`; use cases `*Command`/`*Query`; DTOs between layers, never expose domain entities; `*Details`/`*Summary`; separate interface/implementation projects.

**Tests:** Offer to add applicable business-logic tests in `tests/`; only test controlled code, not framework code. New production projects go in `src/`, tests in `tests/`; test projects use `xUnit`. Use `xUnit`, Arrange-Act-Assert with whitespace only, mirrored feature folders, separate unit/integration projects or folders. Do not name test classes with "Tests" suffix; use "Tests" suffix for folders if needed. Example: `ProductServiceTests/ProductService_Constructor.cs`. Use `[Fact]`, `[Theory]`/`[InlineData]`; class names `ClassName_MethodName.cs`; methods `DoesSomething_GivenSomeCondition`, forming a proper sentence.
